_description: Phase 5 capability fixture: material.preset across all four texture builders (concrete/brick/brushed_metal/marble) plus a few flat (non-textured) presets. Two real bugs were found and fixed using this fixture: (1) the texture-builder dispatch was never actually wired into setup_objects, so every preset silently rendered flat -- confirmed via a completely flat close-up render, then fixed; (2) TexBrick patterned as vertical stripes on a wall face (the exact 'wall UV' problem the Tier-2 plan's Phase 6 warns about, surfacing here too) until wired through a synthetic X+Y wall coordinate; (3) an initial marble attempt fed noise directly into Voronoi's Vector input, collapsing the 3D coordinate to a 1D diagonal and rendering flat -- replaced with the standard banded-Wave-distorted-by-noise marble recipe.
